shellCommands.command: ls -la && git ls-files | head -50 && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules 2>/dev/null | head -50

cat src/*.tsx src/vite-env.d.ts index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json .gitignore; ls __agent_eval__; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui node_modules/@tanstack; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep -n '"version"'

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls build/esm/components/Table build/esm/components/Table/hoc; cat build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.d.ts build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.d.ts; cat build/esm/components/Pagination/types.d.ts

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table && sed -n 1,200p Table.d.ts; cat hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.js | head -150; grep -n "selectedIds\|getRowId\|getHeadCellContent\|indeterminate" hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.js

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && grep -n "withTableSorting\|withTableSelection\|Pagination\|Label\b\|export \* from \"./Flex\|Text/" components/index.d.ts | head; grep -rn "onUpdate" components/Pagination/components/*.js components/Pagination/hooks/*.js 2>/dev/null | head -20; ls components/Pagination components/Pagination/*

cat components/Pagination/components/PaginationPageSizer/PaginationPageSizer.js | sed -n 1,40p; grep -n "withTable" components/Table/index.d.ts components/Table/hoc/index.d.ts; cat components/Pagination/i18n/ru.json; grep -rn "lang\|Lang" components/../i18n/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; ls
grep -rn "lang" components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts components/theme/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null; grep -rln "export declare const configure\|export declare function configure" . | head -3

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='src/data.ts'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("const FIRST_NAMES = ['Анна', 'Иван', 'Мария', 'Пётр', 'Ольга', 'Алексей', 'Елена', 'Дмитрий', 'Наталья', 'Сергей'];",
"const FEMALE_NAMES = ['Анна', 'Мария', 'Ольга', 'Елена', 'Наталья'];\nconst MALE_NAMES = ['Иван', 'Пётр', 'Алексей', 'Дмитрий', 'Сергей'];")
s=s.replace("const firstName = pick(FIRST_NAMES);","const firstName = pick(isFemale ? FEMALE_NAMES : MALE_NAMES);")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
grep -n "NAMES" src/data.ts
sed -i 's|<ThemeProvider theme="light">|<ThemeProvider theme="light" lang="ru">|' src/main.tsx && grep -n ThemeProvider src/main.tsx && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -20

ls node_modules | grep -iE "jsdom|happy-dom|playwright|puppeteer|testing-library"; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; head -40 __agent_eval__/run.mjs

cat > vitest.tmpcheck.config.ts <<'EOF'
export default { test: { server: { deps: { inline: [/@gravity-ui/] } } } };
EOF
npx vitest run --config vitest.tmpcheck.config.ts src/tmp-check.test.tsx 2>&1 | grep -v "^$" | tail -40

rm src/tmp-dump.test.tsx && sed -i \
 -e 's#const rows = (html: string) => (html.match(/<tr class="g-table__row\[^"\]\*"/g) ?? \[\]);#const rows = (html: string) => (html.slice(html.indexOf("<tbody")).match(/<tr class="g-table__row[^"]*"/g) ?? []);#' \
 -e 's#g-table__cell_primary\[^>\]\*>#g-table__cell_primary[^>]*>#' \
 -e 's#<td class="g-table__cell">(\\d+)<\\/td>#<td class="g-table__cell g-table__cell_edge-padding">(\\d+)<\\/td>#' src/tmp-check.test.tsx && grep -n "const rows\|edge-padding" src/tmp-check.test.tsx && npx vitest run --config vitest.tmpcheck.config.ts src/tmp-check.test.tsx 2>&1 | grep -v "^$" | tail -25

sed -i \
 -e "s|const FEMALE_NAMES = \['Анна', 'Мария', 'Ольга', 'Елена', 'Наталья'\];|const FEMALE_NAMES = ['Анна', 'Мария', 'Ольга', 'Елена', 'Наталья', 'Ирина', 'Татьяна', 'Светлана'];|" \
 -e "s|const MALE_NAMES = \['Иван', 'Пётр', 'Алексей', 'Дмитрий', 'Сергей'\];|const MALE_NAMES = ['Иван', 'Пётр', 'Алексей', 'Дмитрий', 'Сергей', 'Андрей', 'Михаил', 'Николай'];|" \
 -e "s|'Новиков', 'Фёдоров'\];|'Новиков', 'Фёдоров', 'Морозов', 'Волков', 'Лебедев', 'Козлов'];|" src/data.ts && sed -n 13,16p src/data.ts && npx vitest run --config vitest.tmpcheck.config.ts src/tmp-check.test.tsx 2>&1 | grep -E "✓|×|Tests" ; rm -rf src/tmp-check.test.tsx vitest.tmpcheck.config.ts && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -3 && rm -rf dist && git status --short
